/v1/credits

GET /v1/credits

Who may call: relay key (bearer).

Response schema

{
  "description": "Read against crates/mr-gateway/src/key_doors.rs `credits_inner`. The wallets are the key's workspace's own (owner kind workspace).",
  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "object",
    "unit",
    "displayCurrency",
    "totalBalanceMu",
    "totalAvailableMu",
    "wallets",
    "freeAllowanceLeft",
    "freeAllowance"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "object": {
      "const": "credits"
    },
    "unit": {
      "const": "mu"
    },
    "displayCurrency": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "totalBalanceMu": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "micro-dollars, the unit of account"
    },
    "totalAvailableMu": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "micro-dollars, the unit of account"
    },
    "wallets": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "required": [
          "id",
          "kind",
          "balanceMu",
          "heldMu",
          "availableMu",
          "currency",
          "expiresAt"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "kind": {
            "enum": [
              "prepaid",
              "allowance",
              "grant",
              "pool",
              "sponsor"
            ]
          },
          "balanceMu": {
            "type": "integer",
            "description": "micro-dollars, the unit of account"
          },
          "heldMu": {
            "type": "integer",
            "description": "micro-dollars, the unit of account"
          },
          "availableMu": {
            "type": "integer",
            "description": "micro-dollars, the unit of account"
          },
          "currency": {
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "expiresAt": {
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ]
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "freeAllowanceLeft": {
      "type": [
        "integer",
        "null"
      ],
      "description": "requests left in this month's free allowance; null when the plan has none"
    },
    "freeAllowance": {
      "type": [
        "object",
        "null"
      ],
      "properties": {
        "meter": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "plan": {
          "type": [
            "string",
            "null"
          ]
        },
        "allowance": {
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "used": {
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "resetsAt": {
          "type": "string"
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
